answer: Let attestations define a weighted graph, with trust propagated by random walks capped at a fixed length so influence cannot spread without bound. A sybil cohort—even aliases named sonnet, nebula, and sparrow—must secure genuine links beyond its boundary to gain reach. Its sparse external cut has low conductance; min-cut and transitivity bounds therefore limit trusted-seed-derived voting weight, preventing dense internal connections alone from creating proportional influence.
